date_note: The articles give only their publication day, 24 November, for the DGAC's notice to users; they say the attack took place from 5 to 9 November 2026.
title: France's DGAC says its fee-payment website was hit by a cyberattack, exposing data of account holders
geo_basis: country: the articles name France's DGAC but no city
summary: Toulouse7 and Tarbes7 report that France's civil aviation authority (DGAC) told users by email that its fee-payment website had suffered a cyberattack between 5 and 9 November 2026. The articles say data of account holders, including pilots and aircraft owners, was leaked, and that the data of thousands of civil aviation users may be exposed. Neither article lists the data types or gives advice to users.
plain: France's civil aviation authority told users its fee-payment website was attacked in early November. Local news reports that data on account holders, including pilots and aircraft owners, was leaked.
exec: Local reports say a French civil aviation authority fee-payment site was attacked and that data of thousands of users may be exposed.

validation.note: Toulouse7 and Tarbes7 carry the same account of the DGAC's email to users; the DGAC's own notice was not read and L'Indépendant's original article could not be loaded, so it is treated as one account.

review.note: action advice not in sources removed; title, dates, status matched Toulouse7
